crossRefs.note: If I would count them, they are more in number than the sand. When I wake up, I am still with you.
For David says concerning him, ‘I saw the Lord always before my face, for he is on my right hand, that I should not be…
By faith, he left Egypt, not fearing the wrath of the king; for he endured, as seeing him who is invisible.
Nevertheless, I am continually with you. You have held my right hand.
My flesh and my heart fails, but God is the strength of my heart and my portion forever.
For he will stand at the right hand of the needy, to save him from those who judge his soul.
The Lord is at your right hand. He will crush kings in the day of his wrath.
Yahweh is your keeper. Yahweh is your shade on your right hand.
he who doesn’t lend out his money for usury, nor take a bribe against the innocent. He who does these things shall…
He alone is my rock and my salvation, my fortress. I will not be shaken.

translations.web: I have set Yahweh always before me. Because he is at my right hand, I shall not be moved.
translations.bsb: I have set the LORD always before me. Because He is at my right hand, I will not be shaken.
translations.kjv: I have set the LORD always before me: because he is at my right hand, I shall not be moved.
translations.asv: I have set Jehovah always before me: Because he is at my right hand, I shall not be moved.
